blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is confident that its next witnesses will appear before the Senate impeachment court, amid the withdrawal and request to be excused Monday of the two individuals initially lined up to testify. Defense counsel and spokesperson Michael Poa said this on Monday, adding that the team was relying on court-issued subpoenas to ensure the attendance of its witnesses. Poa was asked how concerned the defense was that its witnesses might back out after their identities were disclosed, following the withdrawal of former defense witness Dean Ralph Sarmiento, who cited “personal reasons” […]...
